notes.title: Small Update + H.E.N.T.A.I. Upcoming News!
notes.content:
We have fixed a couple of minor issues and put a few of our fellow H.E.N.T.A.I. Battalion members back down to Earth (imaginary enemies are no longer counted in current scores, everybody, let’s play fair). 

And now we are working on an exciting new (and pretty dark) piece of DLC..

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c0w5yHO.gif[/img]

Yours,
Konnichiwa Games


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159640/HENTAI__World_War_II/

notes.title: Unpade 4: new weapon for everybody!
notes.content:
We wanted to introduce you our newest weapon of choice: when near the enemies just hit him hard with a [b]trench shove[/b]l and.. well, it's deadly. (hit the number 6)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TncuOSR.gif[/img]

Besides, there is one more hidden secret option of dealing with those guys.. You can always choose to randomly through a [b]grenade[/b] their way.. and enjoy the show! (just hit the G button)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xTrpVWo.gif[/img]


[h1]Please leave your comments and suggestion below and enjoy the game![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159640/HENTAI__World_War_II/

notes.title: Update 3: Achievements & Leaderboard
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841660/bc1117cf41f0a4a10a9ae5ab9f3f8f49ed64aa99.png[/img]

No war would go far without a splash of completion and - lets be frank - the Winners.. We’ve implemented the [b]leaderboard system[/b] with that reason in mind: from now on, the best of us would be forever remembered to the H.E.N.T.A.I. battalion!

Besides that, there are now [b]Steam Achievements[/b] added to the game. We are excited to introduce you to our ranks system! 

[h1]Please leave your comments below and enjoy the game![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159640/HENTAI__World_War_II/

notes.content:

We are happy to introduce our bettered and more exciting equipment — choose whatever your heart desires and smash them all!

You choose any of the equipment below and enjoy yourself at the battlefield:
[list]
[*] Thompson rifle
[*] old but good shotgun
[*] Mosin sniper rifle
[*] Colt pistol
[*] MP-40 (enemies' weapon)
[/list]

notes.title: First Update: Character Customization
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k4vPW56.gif[/img]

[h1]Clothes off everybody![/h1] Now we have an option of changing up clothes on our beautiful soldiers. Let's make this fight as glorious as it possible could be with the new undressable H.E.N.T.A.I. battalion!


If you are interested in the game - please [b]add it to your Steam Wishlist![/b]
The game will cost only 1$ with 40% OFF (0.59$) in the first week :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159640/HENTAI__World_War_II/

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games
